module.title: Outbox Projection, Reconciliation and Deletion Propagation
module.business_purpose: Guarantees that derived NoSQL/search/cache/vector/object projections can be rebuilt, reconciled, repaired and deleted without dual-write inconsistency. All domain writes commit only to PostgreSQL plus outbox; persistent workers update secondary stores idempotently.
